_comment: DailyTown project config for game_analysis/asset_pipeline. Run the game_analysis scripts with --config pointing here; every relative path resolves against this directory. Outputs are review candidates only: nothing under design/pipeline/output may be referenced by an Android source set until a human approves it (docs/visual/DEV_IMAGE_PIPELINE.md).
